name: Confess To Me
source:
Confess to Me is an intimate 18+ kinetic visual novel about power, control, and a relationship that crosses a dangerous line.

You are someone who needs answers.

She is a courier who finds herself locked inside an interrogation room after her latest delivery.

She insists she knows nothing.

But time is running out, the pressure keeps building, and what begins as a simple interrogation slowly turns into something far more personal.

Every new encounter changes the dynamic between you. Fear gives way to anticipation. Resistance turns into dependence. And the line between a captive and someone who no longer wants to leave becomes increasingly blurred.

But one question remains:

What are you really trying to get from her?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5187700/Confess_To_Me/]Steam[/url]]
